title: Wave 19 - promoted from rnd: nemotron-3.5-lightning needs its context raised under Claude Code
verifier_note: Promotion, not a research swarm. The run counts were re-read by the R&D seat on 2026-10-20 against the atlas-mcp-utility shakedown reports recovered read-only from the atlas-pilot sandbox (receipts named with their SHA-256 in verification.md). The default-context result is a halted shakedown, stated as such. The fill-check figures have no surviving record and are recorded as unverified. No second model family.

extras.name: nemotron-3.5-lightning under Claude Code: set num_ctx 131072 in a derived model (verified)
extras.note: VERIFIED against the run records (atlas-mcp-utility shakedown reports, recovered from the atlas-pilot sandbox on 2026-10-20). Run as Claude Code 2.1.197's model through Ollama's Anthropic-compatible endpoint, a derived model nemotron-3.5-lightning-131k (FROM nemotron-3.5-lightning:latest, PARAMETER num_ctx 131072) answered a small code-reading task set: 4 of 4 correct on task RC03 and 11 of 12 across the four tasks (2026-10-14, all 12 answered); two later rounds gave 9 of 12 (11 answered, one hit the turn cap) and 9 of 12 (10 answered, two hit the turn cap). Each run used both arms of the harness (with and without the Atlas MCP sidecar). A small task set, not a benchmark: the finding is the context setting, not a ranking.

extras.name: At Ollama's default 32,768 context, Claude Code's own prompt crowds nemotron out (halted shakedown)
extras.note: FROM A HALTED SHAKEDOWN, NOT A RESULT. With the base model at Ollama's default context of 32,768 tokens, of which Claude Code's system prompt and tools take about 25,000 to 28,000, nemotron-3.5-lightning answered 1 of 4 runs of task RC03 correctly (2026-10-13). The shakedown was halted when a run called a tool its arm does not have, and it does not count toward any decision. It is the reason the derived 131k model exists. Check what loaded with Ollama's /api/ps (context_length); /api/show reports the num_ctx parameter without loading.

extras.name: nemotron-3.5-lightning-131k stays resident on the RTX 5090, peaking near 28 GB (unverified)
extras.note: UNVERIFIED: raw records not kept. A fill check on the rig on 2026-10-13 reported size_vram equal to size on load, a peak of 27,862 MiB, and 27,986 MiB for a 65,538-token prompt, fully resident. No log of that check survives on the rig or in any session record (searched 2026-10-20), so the figures are recorded as reported, not checked.
